payload.text: St. Edward's University in Austin, Texas Take On Your World Explore St. Edward’s Discover Your Hilltop The energy of our Hilltop campus empowers you to take on your world. ​With distinctive academics, our tight-knit community rooted in Holy Cross values ​welcomes all backgrounds and prepares you to pursue your passions. Academics Your Success Starts Here With 55+ undergraduate and graduate degrees to choose from, our students pursue rigorous academics, thrive on our vibrant campus and engage with Austin and the world. We are ranked #5 in the West by U.S. News & World Report , a testament to our student-first approach and enriching academic environment that sparks discovery, creativity and purpose. Explore Academic Programs Our Top 10 Reasons for Hilltop Pride #2 Undergrad Teaching in the West Austin Opportunity Awaits at a Top Texas University Austin's thriving economy and unique cultural scene allow our students to gain hands-on experience through local internships and access to iconic events. Through our strategic partnerships, students can apply what they’re learning in a world-class city and make a lasting impact. See Yourself in Austin 17 Reasons We Love Austin #3 Best Value School in the West Hilltop Experience Meet Your Community Our students fuel the vibrancy of our campus, our home on the Hilltop just three miles from downtown Austin. In every corner, you’ll feel a sense of belonging through a variety of student organizations, campus traditions, beautiful spaces and the freedom to shape your own identity and path.
